prayerExcerpt.en-US: May we pursue the surpassing knowledge of Jesus Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Concedei-nos, Senhor, o incomparável conhecimento de Jesus Cristo.

meta.face: A pale, slender Lombard of about thirty-six with a LONG OVAL face in three-quarter view — a high forehead with the dark hair already receding at the temples, a long, straight, prominent nose with a slightly lowered tip, deep-set dark-brown eyes under straight dark brows drawn a little together, flat cheeks over a strong cheekbone, a firm, closed mouth; short dark-brown hair lying close to the head and behind the ear; a full dark-brown moustache and a dense dark-brown beard trimmed close on the cheeks and ending in a short, squared POINT below the chin; an intent, far-seeing gaze lifted to the right. Not a young long-haired Christ type: the hair is short and receding.
meta.basis: The traditional portrait on Wikipedia, which we checked, shows a pale man in a high-collared black cassock in profile, with a receding hairline, a long nose, deep-set eyes and a dark beard ending in a point; he died at thirty-six in 1539. Cremona, the monstrance and the lily follow his life and the usual attributes.
